tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search current robotics, humanoid, embodied AI and Physical AI roles from PhysicalAI.jobs by keyword, specialty, company, location, remote status and compensation. Use this when a user wants to discover or shortlist relevant jobs.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Retrieve additional sanitized public details for one PhysicalAI.jobs listing. Use this after search_jobs or latest_jobs when the user wants more information. The result links back to PhysicalAI.jobs and never exposes a hidden employer ATS URL.

tools.name: latest_jobs
tools.description: Find the newest current Physical AI, robotics, humanoid, embodied AI, autonomy, manipulation, perception and controls jobs on PhysicalAI.jobs. Use this for recent-job or jobs-since-a-date questions.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search public PhysicalAI.jobs company profiles and optionally restrict results to companies that currently have public live jobs. Use this for questions about robotics, humanoid or embodied AI companies and who is hiring.
